posts.subject: [ENG] Administrator Application (Requirements) Read before posting !
posts.bodyHtml:
You have fun on our game servers and want to support us administratively?
Then you can apply to become our administrator.
In this topic you will find the requirements.


The minimum age of 16 must be achieved.
There are NO exceptions


Please do not submit questions whether it is possible to become administrator at younger age, such requests/ questions will be ignored.
For a long time we have tolerated younger age groups, but the experience shown us that minimum age is quite reasonable.


Active in all areas of community (Game server, TS3, Forum)
-> A minimum of 500 forum points is required
-> A minimum of 3000 stamm points is required on Game Servers
-> A minimum of 5000 stamm points is required on Game Servers if you're applying for Jail or TTT


Own a headset
A headset is required to communicate with other users.
An administrator who looks for communication via chat only and is unable to communicate verbally is not what we imagine to be an administrator in the community.


Assertiveness
If a user violates our game server rules, we are expected to react accordingly.
If the user gives excuse such as "I have not seen it" or "It's friend of mine on TeamSpeak", they do not apply, you're an administrator and you're the one to deal with such situations and not be recognized for the power of position you have.


Maturity
User: Admin, you're a son of a bitch.
Admin: No, the only son of a bitch here is you.


We do not tolerate such a behavior form an administrator under any circumstances. Such thing can lead to being kicked out of team and excluded from becoming a part of admin team. As an admin you're not there to make players follow the rules but you also represent our community, with such powers maturity is required and we expect our admins to be serious and clear-minded, if this is not achieved this can lead to complications and uncomfortable situations.


In addition, the following is expected of you:
- Respect for other administrators and members
- Loyalty and loyalty which takes a big part here


It's not possible to become a administrator if ANY of your accounts have a VAC BAN.
( If the VAC BAN is more than 100 days old, the rule will not apply )


More you can find here: [ENG] Forum Ranks


[Bild]
Test-administrators receive the following rights:
- Limited rights on Dream Server of his choice
- Access to sourcebans
- Rights on the forum as well TS3 and invitation to DREAM TEAM ~ Steam group
- Access to administrator section in forum


[Bild]
Administrators receive the following rights:
- Rights to two Dreams Servers of his choice
- Access to sourcebans
- Rights on the forum as well TS3 and invitation to DREAM TEAM ~ Steam group
- Access to administrator section in forum



After having a successful application you will be invited to our TS3 interview which you get a choice if the date suits you.
Only after successful interview application acceptance is possible.


Once a person is accepted they become a Test-administration and the test phase begins, After the test phase the person is considered if they should be administrator or not, the test phase has no set time limit.


The ranks of Super-administrator and higher are only available if age of 18 and over is achieved.
More can be found here [ENG] Forum Ranks


For people that are active as Test-administrator, administrator or administrator + activity is required in 48 hours ( in extreme cases )
If you're inactive for more than 3 days ( 72 hours ) without letting the leadership know you can face being removed from the administrator team.
This applies to both Game server and TeamSpeak3.


The administrator can submit his inactivity in a administrator section in forum to which he has access.


We want to involve every admin in our community, we don't want people just to have right but have no relationship to the team and always act with their rights.
The loyalty is the most important part in becoming a administrator, as administrator you should always be 100% behind the community and should be there if problems arise.


Cheating is strictly prohibited
If a administrator member is caught cheating on ANY of his accounts, he will not only be removed from the admin team but will also receive a complete community exclusion, so please stay off using any cheats.


We are awaiting for applicants that are active in TS3, game server and forum, Anyone who just wants to have rights without being actively taking part and without being present in all areas should not even submit their application.


If you're became a administrator, please add @Sky, @BlackFire or @Nachtfrische on Steam for having your rights allocated in correct game server, as well so you can receive a private group invitation.


You can find their steam account as following:
Sky
BlackFire
